content.text:
I submitted index 19 (Co 0.34 / Sb 0.66) as the best composition, with an EQE of 0.0124%. That is a very weak response. It was the only positive result of the three merit measurements, and all three are close to zero.

| Index | Composition (Co / Sb) | What it targets | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 19 | 0.34 / 0.66 | CoSb2O6 | **0.0124** |
| 6 | 0.76 / 0.24 | Co7Sb2O12 (Co-rich) | −0.0059 |
| 23 | 0.23 / 0.77 | Sb-rich side of CoSb2O6 | −0.0090 |

- **Why index 19 first:** it sits at the composition of CoSb2O6, which the stability model (MACE) puts on the stability hull, so the phase should form there. The band-gap model (MEGNet) predicts 0.37 eV for it. That is probably too low for cobalt oxides, so I didn't rely on it.
- **Why index 6:** the stability model puts Co7Sb2O12 close to the hull, and the band-gap model predicts 1.44 eV, below the 2.1 eV illumination. It gave no photoresponse.
- **Why index 23:** the Gaussian-process suggestion tool picked it. It also gave no photoresponse.

Three measurements spread over 30 compositions leave most of the library untested, especially between indices 7 and 18 and at both ends. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase identifications above come from the models and were never checked against the films.
